title: Purpose in Christ
definition: Purpose in Christ means that a believer's life has meaning, calling, usefulness, and direction because they belong to Jesus.
summary: Purpose is not based on worldly achievement, physical ability, past success, or human approval. In Christ, every believer is called to glorify God, love others, serve faithfully, and bear witness to the Gospel.
christFocus: Christ gives His people identity, mission, gifts, and hope for faithful service.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Purpose is not based on worldly achievement, physical ability, past success, or human approval. In Christ, every believer is called to glorify God, love others, serve faithfully, and bear witness to the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
